category: Physical Components or Objects Related to a Printed Book
explanation: Page, Cover, and Spine are all physical components of a book. A Bookmark is a physical object used with a book. Chapter refers to a division of the book's content, not a physical part or object.
Augustus, Nero, Trajan, and Hadrian were all Roman Emperors. Julius Caesar was a Roman general and statesman who held the title of dictator, but he was never an emperor.

Silent, Empty, Barren, and Void all describe a state of absence or lack (lack of sound, contents, life/fertility, or anything, respectively). Dense describes a state of presence or abundance (closely packed together).
